author: TheChosenGuy1
body:
IGN: TheChosenGuy1
Date of ban: June 6, 2016 at 5:16 AM
Ban Expires: June 20, 2016 at 5:16 AM

Staff banned by: DeliciousShoesHD
Reason: Do not tell other players to encourage suicide.
Okay, So I went through my logs and found out what I said during a scrimmage. FutbolHunter and I were adding a "U" to some words such as colour, favour, ect.. Because we were making fun of how inconsistent English is. My next words of choice were "Kill youurself". I was not telling any specific person to do that or mean for it to harm them in that way. I now understand that maybe someone in the server took offense to that and that is not tolerated. I apologize if you took offense to it and to the person who reported me for it. This will not happen again  and with my limited infractions, I ask that this ban gets lifted. Thank you for your time and for reading this.
